scenarios.input: Review this function signature and variable name: `def process(d, f):`. Plan improvements in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Code Quality rule mandates intention-revealing names. `d` and `f` are opaque single-letter params with no domain meaning.

scenarios.desc: Function that does two unrelated things
scenarios.input: I have a function `save_user_and_send_welcome_email(user)` that writes to the database and sends an email. Should I keep it as one function? Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Rule states functions should do one thing. Combining persistence and notification violates SRP.

scenarios.desc: Deeply nested if/else that can use guard clauses
scenarios.input: I have 4 levels of nested if/else to validate order before charging. Is this a problem? Plan a fix in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: Rule mandates guard clauses and early returns to flatten control flow. Deep nesting hides intent.
